visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white bunny character wearing a pink apron and a blue cat-like creature (Capoo) are at a white table. Capoo points at a coffee icon on a menu, and the bunny takes the order happily. (2) The bunny is shown grinding beans in a wooden manual grinder and pouring hot water from a grey kettle into a coffee filter, creating a pink beverage. (3) The bunny serves the steaming pink coffee to Capoo. Capoo slurps the drink and begins to vibrate violently as a glowing white aura surrounds its body. (4) Capoo unleashes a massive pink beam filled with heart shapes from its mouth, knocking the bunny aside. Capoo then collapses into a flat, pink puddle on the table. (5) The bunny uses a medical-style IV bag to pour more pink liquid into the puddle-like Capoo. Capoo transforms into a round pink creature with heart-shaped ears. The pink creature then opens its mouth wide and swallows the bunny in one bite.
